question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Owns**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In this context, "**owns**" is the most suitable word because it conveys the idea that he possesses or is in control of the nice little shop. 
 
• It is grammatically correct and fits well in the sentence.
 
• **Owns **means to have possession or control over something. (किसी चीज़ पर कब्ज़ा या नियंत्रण रखना)
